name: AMA Trader
summary: AMA Trader is an Expert Advisor based on Kaufman's Adaptive Moving Average (AMA), which dynamically adjusts its smoothing constant based on market volatility. It generates buy and sell signals when the AMA direction changes, adapting to trending versus ranging markets. The EA opens positions on AMA signal reversals and manages exits through opposite signals or stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: AMA Trader是一个基于考夫曼自适应移动平均线（AMA）的智能交易系统，根据市场波动性动态调整平滑常数。当AMA方向发生改变时产生买卖信号，能够自适应趋势市和震荡市。EA在AMA信号反转时开仓，通过反向信号或止损水平管理出场。
strategy_analysis: AMA Trader的核心策略基于Kaufman自适应移动平均线（AMA），该指标通过效率系数（ER）和快速/慢速平滑常数的组合来动态调整其对价格变化的敏感度。入场条件为AMA方向发生改变：当AMA从下降转为上升时产生买入信号，当AMA从上升转为下降时产生卖出信号。出场条件主要依赖AMA反向信号，即持有多头时AMA转为下降则平多，持有空头时AMA转为上升则平空。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的计算方式来确定每笔交易的仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA设置了止损和止盈参数来控制单笔交易的风险收益比，但自适应指标本身在震荡市中可能产生频繁的假信号导致连续亏损。整体而言，该策略在强趋势市场中表现较好，但在横盘整理期间容易受到虚假突破的困扰。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of AMA Trader is based on Kaufman's Adaptive Moving Average (AMA), which dynamically adjusts its sensitivity to price changes through the combination of the Efficiency Ratio (ER) and fast/slow smoothing constants. Entry conditions are triggered when the AMA direction changes: a buy signal is generated when AMA turns from declining to rising, and a sell signal when AMA turns from rising to declining. Exit conditions primarily rely on opposite AMA signals - closing longs when AMA turns down and closing shorts when AMA turns up. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an account equity percentage-based calculation to determine trade size. Money management incorporates stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control the risk-reward ratio of each trade, though the adaptive indicator itself may generate frequent false signals during choppy markets leading to consecutive losses. Overall, the strategy performs well in strong trending markets but struggles with false breakouts during sideways consolidation periods.

parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0为不启用

pros: 自适应移动平均线能根据市场波动性动态调整灵敏度，在趋势市中反应快、震荡市中过滤噪音
策略逻辑清晰简洁，信号明确，易于理解和优化
参数较少，降低了过度拟合的风险
pros_en: The Adaptive Moving Average dynamically adjusts sensitivity based on market volatility, reacting quickly in trends and filtering noise in ranges
Clear and concise strategy logic with unambiguous signals, easy to understand and optimize
Fewer parameters reduce the risk of overfitting
cons: 在横盘震荡市中AMA方向频繁切换，容易产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
止损默认为0，若未手动设置则存在无限亏损的风险
缺乏多时间框架确认和额外的过滤条件，单一指标策略的稳健性不足
cons_en: In sideways markets, AMA direction flips frequently, generating numerous false signals that lead to consecutive losses
Stop-loss defaults to 0, posing unlimited loss risk if not manually configured
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and additional filter conditions, reducing the robustness of a single-indicator strategy
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX）或波动率过滤器（如ATR），在横盘市中减少交易频率
加入多时间框架确认机制，例如大周期趋势方向一致时才允许交易
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) or volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to reduce trade frequency during sideways markets
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation, only allowing trades when the higher timeframe trend direction aligns

risk_points: 止损默认为0，若用户未设置则单笔交易风险不可控

risk_points_en: Stop-loss defaults to 0, making single-trade risk uncontrollable if the user doesn't configure it
